mechanics.whenRead: PAUSE. Drawn during the August setup Legacy-deck reading, after 08-04, which stops on this card. Read side B during step 2 at the end of the first August game, then continue the Legacy deck.
rules: Open doors 29 and 48 immediately when this side is read.
mechanics.notes: 29 and 48 are in separate white boxes with red type. What is inside them is not printed on this card.
